title: Managed Backup: collection suspension
content:
For Managed Backup, the collection suspension basis governs contract suspension.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued.

The contract payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

Add invoice payment maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

Equality qualifies.

The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction state is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is active.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be active.

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice payment maturity period plus collection suspension grace period after the source invoice is issued.

The evidence identifies Event reference, Invoice issue time. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Add invoice payment maturity period and then collection suspension grace period UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The comparison uses the fixed handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

Before contract suspension, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Payment restriction state, Event reference, Amount. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference, Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the contract from active to suspended.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is active.

## Hypothetical case

In a hypothetical case, an active contract has an official payment restriction and the exact source invoice retains unpaid principal. At the invoice issue time advanced first by the maturity period and then by the grace period, the time condition is met. Immediately before that boundary, handling provides an explanation and leaves status unchanged.
